source.text: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία πνεύματος, εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί, πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε, τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες, σύμψυχοι, τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες, μηδὲν κατ’ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν, ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν, μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι.

records.literal_gloss: If [there is] any therefore encouragement in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of [the] Spirit, if any affections and compassions, \v 2 fill of me the joy, so that the same you may think, the same love having, united in soul, the one thing thinking, \v 3 nothing according to selfish rivalry nor according to empty glory, but in the humility one another counting surpassing yourselves, \v 4 not the things of yourselves each looking to, but also the things of others each.

en.L: If then [there is] any encouragement in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of [the] Spirit, if any affection and compassion, \v 2 make my joy full, so that you think the same thing, having the same love, united in soul, thinking the one thing, \v 3 [doing] nothing out of selfish rivalry or out of empty glory, but in humility counting one another as surpassing yourselves, \v 4 each not looking to your own things, but each also to the things of others.
en.B: So if being in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gives you any encouragement, if love brings you any comfort, if you share at all in the Spirit, if you have any tender affection and compassion, \v 2 then fill my joy to the brim: be of one mind, hold on to the same love, be united in heart, and set your minds on one aim. \v 3 Do not act out of rivalry or out of a craving for empty glory. Instead, be humble, and regard each other as standing above yourselves. \v 4 Each of you should care not just about your own concerns but about the concerns of others as well.
en.R: You belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and that encourages you. Love comforts you. You share in the Spirit together. You have tender, caring hearts. \v 2 So make me completely full of joy by thinking in the same way. Love each other in the same way, and be united in heart and purpose. \v 3 Do not do anything just to beat others or to make yourselves look important. Be humble, and treat others as more important than yourselves. \v 4 Each of you should care about what matters to other people, not only about what matters to you.

fr.L: Si donc [il y a] quelque encouragement {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, si quelque réconfort de l’amour, si quelque communion de l’Esprit, si quelque tendresse et compassion, \v 2 rendez ma joie pleine, afin que vous pensiez la même chose, ayant le même amour, unis d’âme, pensant une seule chose, \v 3 [ne faisant] rien par rivalité égoïste ni par vaine gloire, mais, dans l’humilité, estimant les autres supérieurs à vous-mêmes, \v 4 chacun ne regardant pas à ce qui le concerne, mais chacun aussi à ce qui concerne les autres.
fr.B: Si donc le fait d’être {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} vous apporte quelque encouragement, si l’amour vous procure quelque réconfort, si vous avez quelque part à l’Esprit, si vous avez de la tendresse et de la compassion, \v 2 alors comblez ma joie : ayez une même pensée, gardez un même amour, soyez unis de cœur et tendez vers un seul but. \v 3 N’agissez pas par rivalité ni par désir de vaine gloire. Au contraire, soyez humbles et considérez les autres comme placés au-dessus de vous-mêmes. \v 4 Que chacun de vous se soucie non seulement de ses propres affaires, mais aussi de celles des autres.
fr.R: Vous appartenez au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et cela vous encourage. L’amour vous réconforte. Vous avez part ensemble à l’Esprit. Vous avez des cœurs pleins de tendresse et de bonté. \v 2 Alors rendez-moi parfaitement heureux en pensant de la même façon. Aimez-vous les uns les autres de la même façon, et soyez unis, avec un même cœur et un même but. \v 3 Ne faites rien seulement pour battre les autres ou pour vous donner de l’importance. Soyez humbles, et traitez les autres comme plus importants que vous-mêmes. \v 4 Que chacun de vous s’occupe de ce qui compte pour les autres, et pas seulement de ce qui compte pour lui.

es.L: Si [hay], pues, algún aliento en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, si algún consuelo de amor, si alguna participación del Espíritu, si algún afecto y compasión, \v 2 {{plural_you:completen|completad}} mi gozo, para que {{plural_you:piensen|penséis}} lo mismo, teniendo el mismo amor, unidos en alma, pensando una misma cosa, \v 3 [no haciendo] nada por rivalidad egoísta ni por vanagloria, sino con humildad, considerando a los demás como superiores a {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}, \v 4 no mirando cada uno por lo suyo propio, sino cada uno también por lo de los demás.
es.B: Así que, si estar en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} {{plural_you:les|os}} da algún aliento, si el amor {{plural_you:les|os}} trae algún consuelo, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} alguna parte en el Espíritu, si {{plural_you:sienten|sentís}} algún afecto tierno y compasión, \v 2 {{plural_you:llenen|llenad}} mi alegría hasta el borde: {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} un mismo sentir, {{plural_you:conserven|conservad}} el mismo amor, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} unidos de corazón y {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} la mente en un mismo propósito. \v 3 No {{plural_you:actúen|actuéis}} por rivalidad ni por afán de vanagloria. Al contrario, {{plural_you:sean|sed}} humildes y {{plural_you:consideren|considerad}} a los demás como superiores a {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}. \v 4 Que cada uno se preocupe no solo por sus propios asuntos, sino también por los de los demás.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes pertenecen|Vosotros pertenecéis}} {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, y eso {{plural_you:los|os}} anima. El amor {{plural_you:los|os}} consuela. {{plural_you:Comparten|Compartís}} juntos el Espíritu. {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} corazones tiernos y compasivos. \v 2 Entonces {{plural_you:llénenme|llenadme}} por completo de alegría pensando de la misma manera. {{plural_you:Ámense|Amaos}} unos a otros de la misma manera, y {{plural_you:estén|estad}} unidos en corazón y en propósito. \v 3 No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} nada solo para ganarles a los demás o para parecer importantes. {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} humildes y {{plural_you:traten|tratad}} a los demás como más importantes que {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}. \v 4 Cada uno debe preocuparse por lo que les importa a los demás, no solo por lo que le importa a sí mismo.

sw.L: Basi ikiwa [kuna] himizo lolote katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ikiwa faraja yoyote ya upendo, ikiwa ushirika wowote wa Roho, ikiwa upendo mwororo wowote na huruma, \v 2 ikamilisheni furaha yangu: fikirini jambo lilelile, mkiwa na upendo uleule, mmoja katika nafsi, mkifikiri jambo moja; \v 3 [msifanye] chochote kwa kushindana kwa ubinafsi wala kwa utukufu mtupu, bali kwa unyenyekevu, kila mmoja akiwahesabu wengine kuwa bora kuliko yeye mwenyewe, \v 4 kila mmoja asiangalie mambo yake mwenyewe tu, bali kila mmoja pia mambo ya wengine.
sw.B: Basi ikiwa kuwa ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kunawatia moyo kwa namna yoyote, ikiwa upendo unawafariji kwa namna yoyote, ikiwa mnashiriki kwa namna yoyote katika Roho, ikiwa mna upendo mwororo na huruma, \v 2 basi ijazeni furaha yangu hadi ifurike: muwe na nia moja, mshikamane katika upendo uleule, muwe wamoja moyoni, na mwelekeze mawazo yenu kwenye lengo moja. \v 3 Msifanye lolote kwa roho ya kushindana wala kwa tamaa ya sifa tupu. Badala yake, muwe wanyenyekevu, kila mmoja akiwaona wengine kuwa bora kuliko yeye mwenyewe. \v 4 Kila mmoja wenu ajali si mambo yake mwenyewe tu, bali pia mambo ya wengine.
sw.R: Ninyi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na hilo linawatia moyo. Upendo unawafariji. Mnashiriki Roho pamoja. Mna mioyo yenye upendo mwororo na huruma. \v 2 Kwa hiyo nijazeni furaha kamili kwa kufikiri kwa namna moja. Pendaneni kwa upendo uleule, na muwe wamoja moyoni na katika kusudi. \v 3 Msifanye chochote ili tu kuwashinda wengine au kujifanya kuwa watu muhimu. Muwe wanyenyekevu, na waoneni wengine kuwa muhimu kuliko ninyi wenyewe. \v 4 Kila mmoja wenu ajali mambo yanayowahusu watu wengine, si yale yanayomhusu yeye peke yake.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 무슨 격려가 있다면, 사랑의 무슨 위로가 있다면, 성령의 무슨 교제가 있다면, 무슨 애정과 긍휼이 있다면, \v 2 여러분은 같은 생각을 품고, 같은 사랑을 가지고, 마음을 합하여, 한 가지를 생각하여 나의 기쁨을 채워 주십시오. \v 3 무슨 일이든지 이기적인 경쟁심이나 헛된 영광으로 [하지] 말고, 겸손한 마음으로 서로 자기보다 남을 낫게 여기십시오. \v 4 각자 자기 일만 돌보지 말고, 각자 다른 사람들의 일도 돌보십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있는 것이 여러분에게 조금이라도 격려가 된다면, 사랑이 여러분에게 조금이라도 위로가 된다면, 여러분이 성령 안에서 조금이라도 함께 나누는 것이 있다면, 여러분에게 따뜻한 애정과 긍휼이 조금이라도 있다면, \v 2 나의 기쁨을 가득 채워 주십시오. 한마음이 되고, 같은 사랑을 품고, 뜻을 합하고, 한 가지 목표에 마음을 두십시오. \v 3 경쟁심이나 헛된 영광을 바라는 마음으로 아무 일도 하지 마십시오. 오히려 겸손하게 서로 남을 자기보다 더 높이 여기십시오. \v 4 여러분은 각자 자기 일만이 아니라 다른 사람의 일도 돌보아야 합니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속해 있고, 그것이 여러분에게 힘을 줍니다. 사랑이 여러분을 위로합니다. 여러분은 성령 안에서 함께 나누는 것이 있습니다. 여러분에게는 따뜻하고 남을 아끼는 마음이 있습니다. \v 2 그러니 같은 생각을 함으로써 나를 기쁨으로 가득 차게 해 주십시오. 같은 사랑으로 서로 사랑하고, 마음과 뜻을 하나로 모으십시오. \v 3 남을 이기려고 하거나 자기를 대단하게 보이려고 무슨 일을 하지 마십시오. 겸손하게, 다른 사람을 자기보다 더 중요하게 여기십시오. \v 4 여러분은 각자 자기에게 중요한 것만이 아니라, 다른 사람에게 중요한 것에도 마음을 써야 합니다.

vi.L: Vậy, nếu có sự khích lệ nào trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, nếu có sự an ủi nào của tình yêu thương, nếu có sự thông công nào của Thánh Linh, nếu có lòng trìu mến và thương xót nào, \v 2 thì hãy làm cho niềm vui của tôi được trọn vẹn, là anh chị em cùng một ý tưởng, cùng một tình yêu thương, hiệp một tâm hồn, cùng nghĩ một điều, \v 3 đừng [làm] điều gì vì sự ganh đua ích kỷ hay vì hư vinh, nhưng hãy khiêm nhường, coi người khác là trổi hơn mình, \v 4 mỗi người đừng chỉ chăm về lợi ích riêng của mình, nhưng mỗi người cũng hãy chăm về lợi ích của người khác.
vi.B: Vậy, nếu việc ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đem lại cho anh chị em sự khích lệ nào, nếu tình yêu thương đem lại cho anh chị em sự an ủi nào, nếu anh chị em có dự phần nào trong Thánh Linh, nếu anh chị em có chút lòng trìu mến và thương xót nào, \v 2 thì hãy làm cho niềm vui của tôi tràn đầy: hãy đồng một ý, giữ cùng một tình yêu thương, hiệp một lòng, và hướng tâm trí về một mục tiêu. \v 3 Đừng làm điều gì vì ganh đua hay vì khao khát hư vinh. Trái lại, hãy khiêm nhường, coi người khác là trổi hơn mình. \v 4 Mỗi người đừng chỉ lo cho việc riêng của mình, nhưng cũng hãy lo cho việc của người khác nữa.
vi.R: Anh chị em thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và điều đó khích lệ anh chị em. Tình yêu thương an ủi anh chị em. Anh chị em cùng nhau dự phần trong Thánh Linh. Anh chị em có tấm lòng dịu dàng và biết quan tâm. \v 2 Vậy hãy làm cho tôi được vui trọn vẹn bằng cách cùng suy nghĩ như nhau. Hãy yêu thương nhau như nhau, và hiệp một trong tấm lòng và mục đích. \v 3 Đừng làm điều gì chỉ để hơn người khác hay để làm cho mình có vẻ quan trọng. Hãy khiêm nhường, và xem người khác là quan trọng hơn mình. \v 4 Mỗi người trong anh chị em nên quan tâm đến những gì quan trọng đối với người khác, chứ không chỉ quan tâm đến những gì quan trọng đối với mình.

pt.L: Se, pois, [há] algum encorajamento {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, se algum consolo de amor, se alguma comunhão do Espírito, se algum afeto e compaixão, \v 2 completem a minha alegria, de modo que pensem a mesma coisa, tendo o mesmo amor, unidos de alma, pensando uma só coisa, \v 3 [não fazendo] nada por rivalidade egoísta nem por glória vazia, mas com humildade considerando uns aos outros superiores a si mesmos, \v 4 cada um não olhando para o que é seu, mas cada um também para o que é dos outros.
pt.B: Portanto, se estar {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} lhes dá algum encorajamento, se o amor lhes traz algum consolo, se vocês têm alguma participação no Espírito, se há em vocês algum afeto terno e compaixão, \v 2 então tornem completa a minha alegria: tenham o mesmo modo de pensar, mantenham o mesmo amor, sejam unidos de coração e tenham a mente voltada para um só objetivo. \v 3 Não ajam por rivalidade nem por desejo de glória vazia. Em vez disso, sejam humildes e considerem os outros superiores a vocês mesmos. \v 4 Cada um de vocês se preocupe não só com os próprios interesses, mas também com os interesses dos outros.
pt.R: Vocês pertencem {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, e isso dá ânimo a vocês. O amor consola vocês. Vocês participam juntos do Espírito. Vocês têm um coração terno e cheio de carinho. \v 2 Então me deixem completamente cheio de alegria, pensando todos do mesmo jeito. Amem uns aos outros do mesmo modo e estejam unidos no coração e no propósito. \v 3 Não façam nada só para vencer os outros ou para parecerem importantes. Sejam humildes e tratem os outros como mais importantes do que vocês mesmos. \v 4 Cada um de vocês se preocupe com o que importa para os outros, e não só com o que importa para si mesmo.

am.L: እንግዲህ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ማንኛውም ማበረታቻ ቢኖር፣ የፍቅር ማንኛውም መጽናናት ቢኖር፣ የመንፈስ ማንኛውም ኅብረት ቢኖር፣ ማንኛውም ርኅራኄና ምሕረት ቢኖር፣ \v 2 ያንኑ ነገር እንድታስቡ፣ ያንኑ ፍቅር ይዛችሁ፣ በነፍስ አንድ ሆናችሁ፣ አንዱን ነገር እያሰባችሁ ደስታዬን ሙሉ አድርጉልኝ፤ \v 3 በራስ ወዳድ ፉክክር ወይም በከንቱ ክብር ምንም [አታድርጉ]፤ ነገር ግን በትሕትና እርስ በርሳችሁ ከራሳችሁ እንደሚበልጡ እየቆጠራችሁ፣ \v 4 እያንዳንዳችሁ የራሳችሁን ነገር ሳትመለከቱ፣ ነገር ግን እያንዳንዳችሁ የሌሎችንም ነገር ደግሞ [እየተመለከታችሁ]።
am.B: እንግዲህ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} መሆናችሁ ምንም ማበረታቻ ቢሰጣችሁ፣ ፍቅር ምንም መጽናናት ቢያመጣላችሁ፣ በመንፈስ ምንም ኅብረት ቢኖራችሁ፣ ምንም ርኅራኄና ምሕረት ቢኖራችሁ፣ \v 2 ደስታዬን እስከ ጫፉ ሙሉ አድርጉልኝ፦ አንድ ሐሳብ ይኑራችሁ፤ ያንኑ ፍቅር ያዙ፤ በልብ አንድ ሁኑ፤ አእምሮአችሁንም በአንድ ዓላማ ላይ አድርጉ። \v 3 በፉክክር ወይም ከንቱ ክብርን በመሻት ምንም አታድርጉ። ይልቁንም ትሑታን ሁኑ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም ሌላውን ከራሱ አስበልጦ ይቁጠር። \v 4 እያንዳንዳችሁ ለራሳችሁ ጉዳይ ብቻ ሳይሆን ለሌሎችም ጉዳይ ትኩረት ስጡ።
am.R: እናንተ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ናችሁ፤ ይህም ያበረታታችኋል። ፍቅር ያጽናናችኋል። በመንፈስ አብራችሁ ትካፈላላችሁ። ርኅሩኅና አሳቢ ልብ አላችሁ። \v 2 ስለዚህ በአንድ ዓይነት መንገድ በማሰብ ደስታዬን ሙሉ አድርጉልኝ። እርስ በርሳችሁ በአንድ ዓይነት ፍቅር ተዋደዱ፤ በልብም በዓላማም አንድ ሁኑ። \v 3 ሌሎችን ለማሸነፍ ወይም ራሳችሁን አስፈላጊ አድርጋችሁ ለማሳየት ብቻ ምንም ነገር አታድርጉ። ትሑታን ሁኑ፤ ሌሎችንም ከራሳችሁ አስበልጣችሁ ተመልከቱ። \v 4 እያንዳንዳችሁ ለእናንተ የሚጠቅመውን ብቻ ሳይሆን ለሌሎች ሰዎች የሚጠቅመውንም አስቡ።

decisions.choice: real conditions that Paul assumes are true: since there is
alternatives: open questions: if there is any, which may not be so
decisions.reason: The four clauses with Εἴ / εἴ use the form of condition that takes the "if" as fact. Paul is not doubting that the Philippians have these things; he is reminding them that they do, as the ground for his appeal in verse 2. The repeated "if" also gives the appeal its force, so the Literal and Balanced levels keep it.

decisions.choice: fellowship given by the Holy Spirit: a shared part in the Spirit
alternatives: a fellowship of spirit: human closeness, team spirit
the fellowship that the Spirit creates among believers (without the sense of sharing in the Spirit)
decisions.reason: πνεύματος has no article and could mean the human spirit. But the first clause names Christ, and Paul elsewhere speaks of "the fellowship of the Holy Spirit" (2 Corinthians 13:14). κοινωνία means having a share in something together: believers share in the one Spirit, and that sharing binds them to each other. The capital S marks this reading; a footnote gives the other.

decisions.choice: deep, warm affection and pity
decisions.reason: σπλάγχνα are literally the inner organs, which Greek speakers treated as the seat of the feelings, much as we speak of the heart. Paul used the word in 1:8 for his own longing for the Philippians. The second word is compassion for someone in need.

decisions.choice: "any" agrees with no noun: a fixed "if there is any"
decisions.reason: In this fourth clause the word for "any" is masculine singular, though the noun after it is neuter plural, so it does not match. The phrase works as a set formula repeated from the first three clauses. Some later manuscripts correct the form; the meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: a shared way of thinking and setting one's mind
decisions.reason: φρονέω, used twice here, is a key word in this letter: it means a whole outlook and attitude (compare 2:5 and 4:2). Paul asks for one mind about what matters, not agreement on every detail. σύμψυχοι, "one-souled", occurs only here in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: selfish rivalry; a hunger for empty honor
decisions.reason: The first word is the self-seeking party spirit Paul named in 1:17, when some preached Christ out of rivalry. The second is literally "empty glory": wanting praise that has nothing behind it.

decisions.choice: humbly giving others the higher place
alternatives: believing that everyone else is better than you in every way
decisions.reason: ταπεινοφροσύνῃ is a lowly view of oneself, a word Greek writers usually used as an insult; Paul makes it a virtue. ἡγούμενοι is a deliberate judgment: treat the other person as ranking above you. It is not a claim about who is more gifted, and verse 4 explains it as caring for others' interests. The same verb is used of Christ in verse 6 (ἡγήσατο), and verse 8 says he humbled himself: the hymn shows the attitude these verses ask for.

decisions.choice: not only one's own interests, but others' as well
alternatives: never one's own interests, only others'
decisions.reason: The "also" (καὶ) matters: Paul does not forbid caring for oneself, but he does not let it be the only concern. τὰ ἑαυτῶν, "their own things", returns in 2:21.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: four plain statements in place of four "if" clauses
decisions.reason: Readers of Readable may take "if" as doubt. Following meaning decision m1, Readable states the four things as facts, then gives the appeal with "So". It also says what "in Christ" means: belonging to him.

decisions.choice: empty glory
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the parts of the Greek compound, so the reader can see the contrast with the glory of God in verse 11. Readable says what it means: wanting to look important.

decisions.choice: participación del Espíritu (L); tener parte en el Espíritu (B); compartir el Espíritu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:5, "comunión" would now be heard as the Lord's Supper or a feeling of closeness; meaning decision m2 reads the phrase as a shared part in the Spirit, which "participación" and "tener parte" say.

decisions.choice: vanagloria
decisions.reason: Spanish "vanagloria" is literally "empty glory" and is the everyday word for craving honor one has not earned, so it keeps both the picture and the sense (meaning decision m6).

decisions.choice: utukufu mtupu (L); tamaa ya sifa tupu (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two parts of the Greek word, "empty glory", as "utukufu mtupu"; Balanced says "tamaa ya sifa tupu" (a craving for empty praise), the hunger for honor that m6 describes. "Majivuno" (boasting, conceit) would name the attitude rather than the craving.

decisions.choice: "성령의 교제" (L); "성령 안에서 함께 나누는 것" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is a shared part in the Spirit, which the Spirit gives (the meaning decision). "교제" is the established church word for this fellowship and is kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable say what it is, since "교제" in everyday Korean usually means dating.

decisions.choice: "헛된 영광" (L); "헛된 영광을 바라는 마음" (B); "자기를 대단하게 보이려고" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a hunger for empty honor (the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep its two parts, empty and glory, as the English does; Readable says what it looks like. "영광" here is not the key term for God's glory, but the Korean keeps the Greek picture.

decisions.choice: "sự thông công của Thánh Linh" (L); "dự phần trong Thánh Linh" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as a shared part in the Spirit, which the Spirit gives (m2). "Thông công" is the church word for fellowship; Balanced and Readable say what it is, a share in the Spirit together.

decisions.choice: "hư vinh" (L, B); "làm cho mình có vẻ quan trọng" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a hunger for empty honor (m6); "hư vinh" is the Vietnamese for vain glory, as in Galatians 5:26.

decisions.choice: comunhão do Espírito (L); participação no Espírito (B); participam juntos do Espírito (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "comunhão", the familiar pairing with the Spirit. Balanced and Readable say "participação" / "participam", which is the sense m2 gives (a shared part in the Spirit) and the word used for the same Greek noun in 1:5.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for God and for Christ are written plainly through the passage.

decisions.choice: ርኅራኄና ምሕረት (tender affection and compassion)
decisions.reason: As in 1:8, the Greek's 'inner parts' are given as the feeling they stood for, "ርኅራኄ" (meaning decision m3), beside "ምሕረት", pity.

source.text: τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὃς ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων οὐχ ἁρπαγμὸν ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα θεῷ, ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου, θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ·

records.literal_gloss: This think among you which also in Christ Jesus, \v 6 who in form of God existing not a thing seized considered the to be equal with God, \v 7 but himself emptied, form of a slave having taken, in likeness of human beings having come to be; and in appearance having been found as a human being \v 8 he humbled himself, having become obedient as far as death, of death but of a cross.

en.L: Think this among you, which [was] also in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, \v 6 who, existing in [the] form of God, did not consider being equal with God a thing to exploit, \v 7 but emptied {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, having taken [the] form of a slave, having come to be in [the] likeness of {{gender:human beings|men}}; and having been found in appearance as a human being, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbled {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, having become obedient as far as death, even death of a cross.
en.B: Among yourselves, think in the way that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus also thought, \v 6 who, being in the form of God, did not treat being equal with God as something to exploit for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \v 7 Rather, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} emptied {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, taking on the form of a servant and coming to share the likeness of {{gender:human beings|men}}. And when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was found in outward form as a human being, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbled {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, becoming obedient all the way to death, death on a cross.
en.R: Think in the same way that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus thought. \v 6 {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} was in the form of God, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not use being equal with God for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own benefit. \v 7 Instead, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} emptied {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took the form of a servant and was born as a human being. In every way people could see, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was a human being. \v 8 And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbled {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} by obeying God all the way to death, even death on a cross.

fr.L: Pensez ceci entre vous, ce qui [était] aussi {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, \v 6 {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui, existant en forme de Dieu, n’a pas considéré l’égalité avec Dieu comme une chose à exploiter, \v 7 mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est vidé {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, ayant pris [la] forme d’un esclave, étant devenu à la ressemblance des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}} ; et, ayant été trouvé par [son] aspect comme un être humain, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est abaissé {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, devenant obéissant jusqu’à la mort, et la mort d’une croix.
fr.B: Entre vous, pensez comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus a pensé, lui aussi, \v 6 {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui, étant en forme de Dieu, n’a pas fait de l’égalité avec Dieu un avantage à exploiter pour {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. \v 7 Au contraire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est vidé {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, en prenant la forme d’un serviteur et en devenant semblable aux {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}}. Et, reconnu à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} aspect extérieur comme un être humain, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est humilié {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} et s’est fait obéissant jusqu’à mourir, jusqu’à mourir sur une croix.
fr.R: Pensez de la même manière que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus a pensé. \v 6 Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} était en forme de Dieu, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne s’est pas servi du fait d’être égal à Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre avantage. \v 7 Au contraire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est vidé {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a pris la forme d’un serviteur et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est né comme un être humain. Pour tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voyaient, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était en tout un être humain. \v 8 Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est humilié {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} en obéissant à Dieu jusqu’à la mort, et même la mort sur une croix.

es.L: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} esto entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, lo cual [hubo] también en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús, \v 6 quien, existiendo en forma de Dios, no consideró el ser igual a Dios como algo de qué aprovecharse, \v 7 sino que se vació a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, tomando [la] forma de esclavo, llegando a ser semejante a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}; y hallado en apariencia como un ser humano, \v 8 se humilló a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, haciéndose obediente hasta la muerte, incluso muerte de cruz.
es.B: Entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} de la manera en que pensó también {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús, \v 6 quien, siendo en forma de Dios, no trató el ser igual a Dios como algo que aprovechar para {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}. \v 7 Al contrario, se vació a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, tomando la forma de siervo y llegando a ser semejante a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}. Y, mostrándose en forma exterior como un ser humano, \v 8 se humilló a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, haciéndose obediente hasta la muerte, una muerte en la cruz.
es.R: {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} de la misma manera que pensó {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús. \v 6 {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} estaba en la forma de Dios, pero no usó el ser igual a Dios para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio beneficio. \v 7 Al contrario, se vació a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}: tomó la forma de un siervo y nació como ser humano. En todo lo que la gente podía ver, era un ser humano. \v 8 Y se humilló a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} obedeciendo a Dios hasta la muerte, y una muerte en la cruz.

sw.L: Fikirini hivi kati yenu, kama ilivyokuwa pia katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, \v 6 ambaye, ingawa alikuwepo katika umbo la Mungu, hakuona kuwa sawa na Mungu kuwa kitu cha kujinufaisha nacho, \v 7 bali alijifanya {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kuwa mtupu, akichukua umbo la mtumwa, akiwa amekuja katika mfano wa wanadamu; na alipoonekana kwa sura ya nje kama mwanadamu, \v 8 alijishusha {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, akiwa mtiifu mpaka kufa, hata kifo cha msalaba.
sw.B: Kati yenu, fikirini kwa namna ambayo {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu pia alifikiri. \v 6 Yeye, ingawa alikuwa katika umbo la Mungu, hakuona kuwa sawa na Mungu kuwa jambo la kutumia kwa faida {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 7 Badala yake, alijifanya {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kuwa mtupu, akachukua umbo la mtumishi na kushiriki mfano wa wanadamu. Na alipoonekana kwa sura ya nje kama mwanadamu, \v 8 alijishusha {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, akawa mtiifu hadi kufa, kifo cha msalabani.
sw.R: Fikirini kwa namna ileile ambayo {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu alifikiri. \v 6 {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikuwa katika umbo la Mungu, lakini hakutumia kule kuwa sawa na Mungu kwa faida {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 7 Badala yake, alijifanya {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kuwa mtupu: alichukua umbo la mtumishi, akazaliwa kama mwanadamu. Kwa kila namna ambayo watu wangeweza kuona, alikuwa mwanadamu. \v 8 Naye alijishusha {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kwa kumtii Mungu mpaka kufa, hata kufa msalabani.

ko.L: 여러분 가운데서 이것을 생각하십시오. 이는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에도 있던 것입니다. \v 6 그분은 하나님의 모습으로 계셨으나, 하나님과 동등하게 되는 것을 붙잡을 것으로 여기지 않으시고, \v 7 오히려 자기를 비우셔서 종의 모습을 취하시고 사람들과 같은 모양으로 나셨습니다. 그리고 겉모양으로 사람으로 나타나셔서, \v 8 자기를 낮추시고 죽기까지, 곧 십자가에서 죽기까지 순종하셨습니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 서로 함께하는 삶 속에서, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께서 품으신 마음을 품으십시오. \v 6 그분은 하나님의 모습을 지니고 계셨지만, 하나님과 동등하심을 자기를 위해 이용할 것으로 여기지 않으셨습니다. \v 7 오히려 자기를 비우셔서 종의 모습을 취하시고, 사람들과 같이 되셨습니다. 그리고 겉모습으로 사람으로 나타나셔서, \v 8 자기를 낮추시고 죽기까지, 곧 십자가에서 죽기까지 순종하셨습니다.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께서 생각하셨던 것처럼 여러분도 생각하십시오. \v 6 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 하나님의 모습을 지니고 계셨지만, 하나님과 동등하신 것을 자기 이익을 위해 쓰지 않으셨습니다. \v 7 오히려 자기를 비우셨습니다. 그분은 종의 모습을 취하셨고, 사람으로 태어나셨습니다. 사람들이 볼 수 있는 모든 면에서 그분은 사람이셨습니다. \v 8 그리고 하나님께 순종하셔서 죽기까지, 곧 십자가에서 죽기까지 하심으로써 자기를 낮추셨습니다.

vi.L: Hãy có ý tưởng này giữa anh chị em, là [ý tưởng] cũng có trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, \v 6 là Đấng vốn ở trong hình thể Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng không xem sự ngang hàng với Đức Chúa Trời là điều để tận dụng cho mình, \v 7 trái lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tự làm cho mình trống không, mang lấy hình thể một nô lệ, trở nên giống như loài người; và khi đã được thấy bề ngoài như một con người, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tự hạ mình xuống, vâng phục cho đến chết, thậm chí chết trên thập tự giá.
vi.B: Giữa anh chị em, hãy suy nghĩ theo cách mà Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} cũng đã suy nghĩ. \v 6 Ngài vốn ở trong hình thể Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng không xem sự ngang hàng với Đức Chúa Trời là điều để dùng cho lợi ích riêng của mình. \v 7 Trái lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tự làm cho mình trống không, mang lấy hình thể một đầy tớ và trở nên giống như loài người. Và khi bề ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được thấy là một con người, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tự hạ mình xuống, vâng phục cho đến chết, chết trên thập tự giá.
vi.R: Hãy suy nghĩ giống như Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đã suy nghĩ. \v 6 {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} vốn ở trong hình thể Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không dùng việc mình ngang hàng với Đức Chúa Trời cho lợi ích riêng của mình. \v 7 Trái lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tự làm cho mình trống không: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mang lấy hình thể một đầy tớ và được sinh ra làm một con người. Theo mọi điều người ta có thể thấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là một con người. \v 8 Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tự hạ mình xuống bằng cách vâng phục Đức Chúa Trời cho đến chết, thậm chí chết trên thập tự giá.

pt.L: Pensem isto entre vocês, o que [houve] também {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, \v 6 o qual, existindo em [a] forma de Deus, não considerou o ser igual a Deus algo a ser explorado, \v 7 mas esvaziou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, tomando [a] forma de escravo, tornando-se semelhante {{gender:aos seres humanos|aos homens}}; e, tendo sido achado na aparência como ser humano, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} humilhou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, tornando-se obediente até [a] morte, e morte de cruz.
pt.B: Entre vocês, pensem do modo como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus também pensou. \v 6 Embora estivesse na forma de Deus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não tratou a igualdade com Deus como algo a explorar em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio proveito. \v 7 Ao contrário, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} esvaziou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, assumindo a forma de servo e passando a partilhar a semelhança {{gender:dos seres humanos|dos homens}}. E, sendo reconhecido pela aparência exterior como ser humano, \v 8 {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} humilhou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, tornando-se obediente até a morte, a morte numa cruz.
pt.R: Pensem do mesmo jeito que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus pensou. \v 6 {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} estava na forma de Deus, mas não usou o fato de ser igual a Deus para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio benefício. \v 7 Em vez disso, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} esvaziou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}: tomou a forma de servo e nasceu como ser humano. Em tudo o que as pessoas podiam ver, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} era um ser humano. \v 8 E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} humilhou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}, obedecendo a Deus até a morte, até a morte numa cruz.

am.L: {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ደግሞ የነበረውን ይህን በመካከላችሁ አስቡ፤ \v 6 እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ሲኖር ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር መተካከልን የሚጠቀምበት ነገር አድርጎ አልቆጠረውም፤ \v 7 ነገር ግን የባሪያን መልክ ይዞ፣ በሰዎች አምሳል ሆኖ ራሱን ባዶ አደረገ፤ በገጽታም እንደ ሰው ሆኖ ተገኝቶ \v 8 እስከ ሞት፣ ያውም እስከ መስቀል ሞት ድረስ የታዘዘ ሆኖ ራሱን አዋረደ።
am.B: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ እንዳሰበ በመካከላችሁ እንዲሁ አስቡ፤ \v 6 እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ሆኖ ሳለ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር መተካከሉን ለራሱ ጥቅም የሚያውለው ነገር አድርጎ አልቆጠረውም። \v 7 ይልቁንም የባሪያን መልክ ይዞና በሰዎች አምሳል ሆኖ ራሱን ባዶ አደረገ። በውጫዊ ገጽታውም እንደ ሰው ሆኖ በተገኘ ጊዜ \v 8 እስከ ሞት፣ ያውም እስከ መስቀል ሞት ድረስ በመታዘዝ ራሱን አዋረደ።
am.R: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ እንዳሰበ እናንተም እንዲሁ አስቡ። \v 6 {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር እኩል መሆኑን ለራሱ ጥቅም አልተጠቀመበትም። \v 7 ይልቁንም ራሱን ባዶ አደረገ፤ የባሪያን መልክ ይዞ ሰው ሆኖ ተወለደ። ሰዎች በሚያዩት በማንኛውም መንገድ እርሱ ሰው ነበር። \v 8 እስከ ሞት፣ ያውም እስከ መስቀል ሞት ድረስ እግዚአብሔርን በመታዘዝ ራሱን አዋረደ።

decisions.choice: the way of thinking that was also in Christ Jesus: his own example
alternatives: the way of thinking you have (or: that is fitting) in Christ Jesus: the outlook that belongs to those who are united with him
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb in this clause, so one must be supplied. Read with "was", Paul points to Christ's own attitude, which the next verses describe step by step: he did not look to his own interests (compare 2:4) and he humbled himself (compare 2:3). The other reading supplies "you think" or "is fitting": think among yourselves the way you think as people who are in Christ Jesus. That fits the way Paul usually uses "in Christ" (as in 4:7) for being united with him. Both readings make good sense, and both lead to the hymn; a footnote gives the other.

decisions.choice: among you: in your life together
decisions.reason: The "you" is plural, and the whole appeal (2:1-4) is about how the church treats one another. The phrase can also mean in each person's own mind; the two go together.

decisions.choice: verses 6-11 read as a poem or hymn
decisions.reason: These verses fall into short, balanced lines, unlike the prose around them. Whether Paul wrote them himself or quoted words the churches already knew cannot be known. Either way he uses them as the example for verses 3-4: the one who was highest made himself lowest.

decisions.choice: in the form of God: having God's own way of being, seen in his status and glory
alternatives: the image of God, as in Adam (Genesis 1:27)
decisions.reason: μορφῇ is the form in which something truly appears, not a disguise. It is paired with "the form of a slave" in verse 7: Christ was as truly in God's form as he was truly a slave. ὑπάρχων ("existing") describes what he already was before he emptied himself. The phrase does not by itself define how Christ relates to the Father; the next clause calls it being equal with God.

decisions.choice: though he was in the form of God
alternatives: because he was in the form of God, he did not ...
decisions.reason: The participle gives the setting for what follows, and the "but" in verse 7 sets what he had against what he did, so "though" is the natural reading. It can also be read "because": being in God's form is the reason he gave himself, which says something about what God is like. Balanced keeps "being", which allows both.

decisions.choice: something to exploit: he did not use his equality with God for his own advantage
alternatives: something to seize: he did not try to grab equality with God, which he did not yet have
something to cling to: he did not hold on to equality with God, but let it go
decisions.reason: ἁρπαγμὸν comes from the verb "to seize" and occurs nowhere else in the New Testament, so its sense must come from context. The verse has just said he already existed in God's form, and the article before "to be equal" points back to that, so the question is not whether he would grab equality but what he would do with it. Verses 3-4 (not looking to one's own interests) and verse 7 (he emptied himself) point to the answer: he did not treat it as something to use for himself. The reading "seize" contrasts Christ with Adam, who reached to be like God (Genesis 3:5); the reading "cling to" also fits verse 7. The words leave room for each, so a footnote gives them.

decisions.choice: emptied himself: made himself nothing, by taking a slave's form and becoming human
alternatives: emptied himself of his divine nature
emptied himself of some divine powers or privileges
decisions.reason: ἐκένωσεν means to make empty or of no account. Paul does not say what Christ emptied himself of; he says how: the two phrases that follow, taking a slave's form and coming to be in human likeness. The emptying is giving, not losing: the one in the form of God took on the form of a slave. Theories about which divine powers Christ set aside go beyond what the verse says, so the translation keeps the bare words "emptied himself".

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: δούλου is the ordinary word for a slave, someone owned by another and without rights. It stands opposite "form of God" here and opposite "Lord" in verse 11. Paul and Timothy call themselves slaves of Christ Jesus in 1:1.

decisions.choice: truly human, as others saw him
alternatives: a male, as opposed to a woman
decisions.reason: ὁμοιώματι (likeness) does not mean a mere appearance: Paul uses it in Romans 8:3, where God sent his Son in the likeness of sinful flesh. σχήματι is the outward bearing others could see: in everything visible he was a human being. The word for human being here is the general one; the point is that he shared our humanity, not his maleness.

decisions.choice: he humbled himself by obeying God, as far as death
alternatives: obedient to death, as if death were his master
decisions.reason: ἐταπείνωσεν is the verb of the noun "humility" in verse 3. The obedience is to God; the text does not say so in words, but there is no one else he could be obeying. "As far as death" measures how far his obedience went. The same phrase is used of Epaphroditus in 2:30.

decisions.choice: crucifixion: the most shameful death
decisions.reason: Rome used crucifixion for slaves, rebels and the lowest criminals; Roman citizens, as many in Philippi were, were normally exempt from it. The Law also said that one hanged on a tree is under God's curse (Deuteronomy 21:23; Galatians 3:13). The slave's form of verse 7 ends in a slave's death.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}
decisions.reason: Every pronoun for Christ uses the deity_pronoun setting. The sentence is arranged so that no such pronoun starts an English sentence, where the two options would look the same.

decisions.choice: {{gender:human beings|men}}
decisions.reason: The plural is the general word for people, so the gender setting applies: the inclusive default, with the traditional "men" one tap away.

decisions.choice: a human being, no setting
decisions.reason: The singular here refers to Christ, a specific man, and the guide never puts a gender setting on Christ. The word's sense in this verse is a human being (meaning decision m9), so every reader sees that.

decisions.choice: was born as a human being; obeying God
alternatives: came to be in human likeness; becoming obedient
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "coming to be in human likeness" means (compare Galatians 4:4) and names God as the one Christ obeyed, which the Greek leaves implied (meaning decision m10).

decisions.choice: exploit (L, B); use for his own benefit (R)
decisions.reason: These follow meaning decision m6. "Grasp" is often used here, but it can mean either seize or cling to, and does not say what the context points to.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it and as is traditional here; the meaning decision (m8) keeps that this is the lowest status, one owned and without rights, set against the form of God, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: the reflexive "s’" without the span; "{{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}" carries it
decisions.reason: French writes the reflexive pronoun before the verb and the stressed "lui-même" after it. The capitalised option is carried by "lui-même", where the English "himself" has it; a capital on "s’" would look odd in French and adds nothing.

decisions.choice: des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}}, aux {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}}; "un être humain" for Christ, with no setting
decisions.reason: As in English: the plural is the general word for people, so it takes the setting, with the article outside the span; the singular refers to Christ, a specific man, and stays "un être humain" at every level, as the meaning decision reads it (m9).

decisions.choice: se vació a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}
decisions.reason: "Vaciarse" keeps the picture of the Greek verb, emptying (meaning decision m6), at every level; how he emptied himself is said by what follows, as in English. The reflexive "se" joined to the verb takes no setting, as "se entregó" in Galatians 2:20; the stressed "sí mismo" does.

decisions.choice: algo de qué aprovecharse (L); algo que aprovechar para sí mismo (B); para su propio beneficio (R)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m5 reads the phrase as something to use for his own advantage, not something to grasp at or hold on to, so Spanish uses "aprovechar" at every level.

decisions.choice: umbo (morphe); alijifanya mwenyewe kuwa mtupu (ekenosen)
decisions.reason: "Umbo" is form or shape, the way a being truly is and appears (m4), and is used for both "the form of God" and "the form of a slave" so that the two stand side by side as in the Greek. "Emptied himself" is kept as an image, "alijifanya mwenyewe kuwa mtupu", rather than explained, so the meaning decision's reading (he made himself nothing by taking a slave's form) stays with the clauses that follow. A native reviewer may prefer a smoother wording.

decisions.choice: alijishusha (humbled himself)
decisions.reason: "Kujishusha" (to lower oneself) shows the movement down that the hymn traces, from the form of God to death on a cross; "kujinyenyekeza" is also correct, and is the familiar word in this verse. The noun "unyenyekevu" is still used for humility in 2:3.

decisions.choice: "종의 모습" at every level
decisions.reason: The English has "slave" in Literal and "servant" in Balanced and Readable. Korean "종" says a person wholly owned and at a master's service (the meaning decision) without the picture of modern slavery, so, as for Paul and Timothy in 1:1, one word serves every level and Christ's form is the same word as theirs.

decisions.choice: "사람들과 같은 모양", "사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal and Balanced offer "human beings" or "men". Korean "사람" already means a human being of either sex, so the gender setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: the honorific on every verb of Christ, even of his self-emptying and death ("비우셔서", "낮추시고", "순종하셨습니다")
alternatives: the plain forms for the humbled Christ
decisions.reason: Korean gives Christ the honorific -시- at every level, as everywhere; the honor does not take away from what the passage says he did, and it carries the respect the English shows with its deity_pronoun setting. Korean has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "tự làm cho mình trống không" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is "emptied himself", made himself nothing by taking a slave's form (m7). Vietnamese keeps the picture of emptying at every level, as the English keeps "emptied", and the clauses that follow say how.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The rule of this letter for doulos (1:1), as the English has "slave" and "servant". The meaning decision says Christ took the lowest form (m8), which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: "loài người", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Loài người" already includes men and women, so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "hình thể Đức Chúa Trời"; "điều để tận dụng cho mình" (L), "điều để dùng cho lợi ích riêng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Hình thể" is God's own way of being, seen in his glory (m4), and the same word is used for the slave's form in verse 7. The meaning decision reads the second phrase as something to exploit for his own advantage (m6), which Vietnamese says plainly; "chiếm đoạt" would suggest that he did not already have it.

decisions.choice: esvaziou a si mesmo; humilhou a si mesmo
decisions.reason: The verb with "a si mesmo" keeps the Greek's stress on the reflexive and gives the deity_pronoun setting a whole pronoun to capitalise ("a Si mesmo"), where a clitic "se" would be awkward under the setting. "Esvaziar" keeps m7's picture of giving, not losing; "aniquilar-se" now sounds like self-destruction.

decisions.choice: algo a ser explorado (L); algo a explorar em seu próprio proveito (B); usar para o seu próprio benefício (R)
decisions.reason: Following m6: Christ already had equality with God and did not use it for his own advantage. "Usurpação", familiar from older Portuguese versions, says he did not seize what he lacked, which m6 sets aside.

decisions.choice: የባሪያን መልክ (the form of a slave) at every level
alternatives: የአገልጋይን መልክ (the form of a servant), as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The hymn sets the form of God beside the form of a slave (meaning decision on 'slave'): the lowest place, not only a task. "ባሪያ" is kept, as for doulos in 1:1 and through Paul's letters.

decisions.choice: በሰዎች አምሳል (in the likeness of human beings) with no gender span
alternatives: a span like the English {{gender:human beings|men}}
decisions.reason: "ሰዎች" already means human beings, women and men, so Amharic has no second wording for the setting to offer.

decisions.choice: ራሱን ባዶ አደረገ (emptied himself) at every level
decisions.reason: The plain picture of emptying is kept, as the Greek has it; "ዝቅ አደረገ" would blur it with 'humbled himself' in verse 8 ("ራሱን አዋረደ"), which the hymn says separately. What the emptying was, the next words say: taking a slave's form and becoming human (meaning decision).

source.text: διὸ καὶ ὁ θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν, καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα, ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων, καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς εἰς δόξαν θεοῦ πατρός.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore also the God him highly exalted and graciously gave to him the name the above every name, \v 10 so that in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of heavenly [ones] and earthly [ones] and under-the-earth [ones], \v 11 and every tongue should confess that Lord [is] Jesus Christ, to glory of God Father.

en.L: Therefore God also highly exalted {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and graciously gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the name that [is] above every name, \v 10 so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of [those] in heaven and on earth and under the earth, \v 11 and every tongue should confess that Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [is] Lord, to [the] glory of God [the] Father.
en.B: That is why God has exalted {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} far above all and freely given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the name that is above every name, \v 10 so that every knee will bend before the name of Jesus, in heaven, on earth and below the earth, \v 11 and every tongue will openly declare that Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is Lord, bringing glory to God the Father.
en.R: So God lifted {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up to the highest honor and gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the name that is greater than every other name. \v 10 God did this so that everyone in heaven, on earth, and under the earth will kneel down to honor the name of Jesus, \v 11 and everyone will say out loud that Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is Lord. This will bring glory to God the Father.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi aussi Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a élevé au-dessus de tout et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a accordé par grâce le nom qui [est] au-dessus de tout nom, \v 10 afin qu’au nom de Jésus tout genou plie, [de ceux qui sont] dans le ciel, sur la terre et sous la terre, \v 11 et que toute langue confesse que Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} [est] Seigneur, pour la gloire de Dieu le Père.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a élevé bien au-dessus de tout et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné, par pure grâce, le nom qui est au-dessus de tout nom, \v 10 afin que devant le nom de Jésus tout genou se plie, dans le ciel, sur la terre et sous la terre, \v 11 et que toute langue déclare ouvertement que Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est Seigneur, à la gloire de Dieu le Père.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a élevé au plus grand honneur et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné le nom qui est plus grand que tous les autres noms. \v 10 Dieu a fait cela pour que tous ceux qui sont dans le ciel, sur la terre et sous la terre se mettent à genoux pour honorer le nom de Jésus, \v 11 et que tous disent à haute voix que Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est Seigneur. Cela donnera gloire à Dieu le Père.

es.L: Por eso también Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} exaltó por encima de todo y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} concedió el nombre que [está] sobre todo nombre, \v 10 para que ante el nombre de Jesús se doble toda rodilla, de [los que están] en el cielo y en la tierra y debajo de la tierra, \v 11 y toda lengua confiese que {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} [es] Señor, para gloria de Dios Padre.
es.B: Por eso Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha exaltado por encima de todo y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado por gracia el nombre que está sobre todo nombre, \v 10 para que ante el nombre de Jesús se doble toda rodilla en el cielo, en la tierra y debajo de la tierra, \v 11 y toda lengua declare abiertamente que {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} es Señor, para gloria de Dios Padre.
es.R: Por eso Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} elevó al lugar de más alto honor y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio el nombre que es más grande que cualquier otro nombre. \v 10 Dios hizo esto para que todos, en el cielo, en la tierra y debajo de la tierra, se arrodillen para honrar el nombre de Jesús, \v 11 y todos digan en voz alta que {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} es Señor. Esto dará gloria a Dios Padre.

sw.L: Ndiyo sababu pia Mungu alimwinua juu kabisa, akampa kwa neema jina lililo juu ya kila jina, \v 10 ili katika jina la Yesu kila goti lipinde, la [walio] mbinguni na [walio] duniani na [walio] chini ya dunia, \v 11 na kila ulimi ukiri waziwazi kwamba Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni Bwana, kwa utukufu wa Mungu Baba.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu Mungu amemwinua juu ya vyote, akampa kwa ukarimu jina lililo juu ya kila jina, \v 10 ili mbele ya jina la Yesu kila goti lipinde, mbinguni, duniani na chini ya dunia, \v 11 na kila ulimi utangaze waziwazi kwamba Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni Bwana, na hivyo kumletea Mungu Baba utukufu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Mungu alimwinua kwenye heshima ya juu kabisa, akampa jina lililo kuu kuliko kila jina jingine. \v 10 Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kila aliye mbinguni, duniani na chini ya dunia apige magoti kuliheshimu jina la Yesu, \v 11 na kila mtu aseme kwa sauti kwamba Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni Bwana. Jambo hili litamletea Mungu Baba utukufu.

ko.L: 그러므로 하나님께서도 그분을 지극히 높이시고, 모든 이름 위에 있는 이름을 그분에게 은혜로 주셨습니다. \v 10 이는 하늘에 있는 [이들]과 땅에 있는 [이들]과 땅 아래에 있는 [이들]이 모두 예수의 이름 앞에 무릎을 꿇고, \v 11 모든 입이 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주님이시라고 고백하여 하나님 아버지께 영광을 돌리게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 하나님께서는 그분을 모든 것 위에 높이시고, 모든 이름 위에 있는 이름을 그분에게 주셨습니다. \v 10 그리하여 하늘에 있는 이들과 땅에 있는 이들과 땅 아래에 있는 이들이 모두 예수의 이름 앞에 무릎을 꿇고, \v 11 모든 입이 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주님이시라고 공공연히 고백하여, 하나님 아버지께 영광을 돌리게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 하나님께서는 그분을 가장 높은 자리로 올리시고, 다른 모든 이름보다 더 위대한 이름을 그분에게 주셨습니다. \v 10 하나님께서 이렇게 하신 것은, 하늘과 땅과 땅 아래에 있는 모든 이가 예수의 이름을 높여 무릎을 꿇게 하시려는 것입니다. \v 11 그리고 모든 사람이 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주님이시라고 소리 내어 말하게 하시려는 것입니다. 이것이 하나님 아버지께 영광을 돌릴 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Đức Chúa Trời cũng đã tôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên tột bậc và ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} danh trên hết mọi danh, \v 10 để nơi danh Giê-xu mọi đầu gối đều phải quỳ xuống, trên trời, dưới đất và bên dưới đất, \v 11 và mọi lưỡi đều phải xưng nhận Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} là Chúa, để làm vinh hiển Đức Chúa Trời là Cha.
vi.B: Vì thế, Đức Chúa Trời đã tôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên cao trên hết mọi sự và ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} danh trổi hơn mọi danh, \v 10 để mọi đầu gối, ở trên trời, dưới đất và bên dưới đất, đều quỳ xuống trước danh của Đức Giê-xu, \v 11 và mọi lưỡi đều công khai xưng nhận Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} là Chúa, đem vinh hiển về cho Đức Chúa Trời là Cha.
vi.R: Vì vậy Đức Chúa Trời đã nâng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên chỗ tôn quý nhất, và ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} danh cao trọng hơn mọi danh khác. \v 10 Đức Chúa Trời làm điều này để mọi loài trên trời, dưới đất và bên dưới đất đều sẽ quỳ gối tôn kính danh của Đức Giê-xu, \v 11 và mọi người đều sẽ nói lớn rằng Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} là Chúa. Điều này sẽ đem vinh hiển về cho Đức Chúa Trời là Cha.

pt.L: Por isso Deus também {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} elevou acima de tudo e {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu como graça o nome que [é] superior a todo nome, \v 10 a fim de que, no nome de Jesus, se curve todo joelho dos [que estão] no céu, na terra e debaixo da terra, \v 11 e toda língua confesse que Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} [é] Senhor, para [a] glória de Deus Pai.
pt.B: Por isso Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} elevou muito acima de tudo e generosamente {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu o nome que está acima de todo nome, \v 10 para que, diante do nome de Jesus, todo joelho se curve, no céu, na terra e debaixo da terra, \v 11 e toda língua declare abertamente que Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} é Senhor, para a glória de Deus, o Pai.
pt.R: Por isso Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levantou até a mais alta honra e deu a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o nome que é maior do que qualquer outro nome. \v 10 Deus fez isso para que todos no céu, na terra e debaixo da terra se ajoelhem para honrar o nome de Jesus, \v 11 e para que todos digam em voz alta que Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} é Senhor. Isso vai trazer glória a Deus, o Pai.

am.L: ስለዚህ ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር እጅግ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው፤ ከስም ሁሉ በላይ የሆነውንም ስም በጸጋ ሰጠው፤ \v 10 ይኸውም በኢየሱስ ስም የሰማያውያንና የምድራውያን ከምድርም በታች ያሉት ጉልበት ሁሉ እንዲንበረከክ፣ \v 11 አንደበትም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር አብ ክብር ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ጌታ [እንደ ሆነ] እንዲመሰክር ነው።
am.B: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ከሁሉ በላይ ከፍ አደረገው፤ ከስም ሁሉ የሚበልጠውንም ስም በልግስና ሰጠው፤ \v 10 ይህም በሰማይ፣ በምድርና ከምድር በታች ያለ ጉልበት ሁሉ በኢየሱስ ስም ፊት እንዲንበረከክ፣ \v 11 አንደበትም ሁሉ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ጌታ መሆኑን በግልጥ እንዲመሰክር ነው፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር አብ ክብርን ያመጣል።
am.R: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ከፍተኛውን ክብር ሰጥቶ ከፍ አደረገው፤ ከሌላው ስም ሁሉ የሚበልጠውንም ስም ሰጠው። \v 10 እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያደረገው በሰማይ፣ በምድርና ከምድር በታች ያሉት ሁሉ ለኢየሱስ ስም ክብር እንዲንበረከኩ ነው፤ \v 11 ሁሉም ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ጌታ መሆኑን ጮክ ብለው እንዲናገሩ ነው። ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር አብ ክብር ያመጣል።

decisions.choice: for this reason: God's answer to Christ's self-humbling
decisions.reason: The turn comes at διὸ: until now Christ has been the one acting; from here God acts. The one who lowered himself is lifted up, as Jesus taught (Matthew 23:12).

decisions.choice: exalted above all; an echo of the Servant in Isaiah 52:13
decisions.reason: The verb is a strengthened form of "lift up, exalt", meaning raised beyond all others. The Greek of Isaiah 52:13 uses the simple form of the same verb of the Lord's Servant, the one who is then humbled to death (Isaiah 53), as Christ is in verses 7-8.

decisions.choice: the name above every name is "Lord"
alternatives: the name "Jesus", now honored above every other name
decisions.reason: In the Bible a name stands for a person's rank and character. Verse 11 says what every tongue will confess: that Jesus Christ is Lord. That is the title God gives him, the one that ranks above every other. "Jesus" in verse 10 is the person who bears it. The verb for giving is the one used for a free gift, from the same root as grace.

decisions.choice: every knee will bow, every tongue confess: Isaiah 45:23
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 45:22-23 the LORD says that he alone is God, and that to him every knee will bow and every tongue will swear. Paul echoes the wording of the Greek translation of that verse, and applies to Jesus the honor that Isaiah says belongs to God alone. Paul quotes the same verse of God in Romans 14:11.

decisions.choice: Lord: the title that the Greek Old Testament gives to God
alternatives: lord: a master or ruler, a title of respect
decisions.reason: κύριος can be a polite "sir" or a slave's master, which would contrast with the slave of verse 7. But in the Greek translation of the Old Testament that Paul quotes, it stands in place of God's own name, the LORD, and the echo of Isaiah 45 here makes that sense clear. Yet the confession is "to the glory of God the Father": giving Jesus this name does not take glory from the Father. "Jesus Christ is Lord" was the earliest Christian confession of faith (Romans 10:9; 1 Corinthians 12:3).

decisions.choice: in honor of the name of Jesus
alternatives: whenever the name of Jesus is spoken
praying in the name of Jesus
decisions.reason: ἐν here gives the one the knees bow to. It is about honoring the person whose name it is, not a gesture at the sound of a word.

decisions.choice: all beings in heaven, on earth and in the realm of the dead
decisions.reason: The three words name every part of creation as the ancient world pictured it: heaven, earth, and the world of the dead below it. No one is left out.

decisions.choice: God's purpose, which will surely be done
alternatives: a promise that every being will be saved
decisions.reason: ἵνα states the goal of God's exaltation of Jesus: in the end every creature will acknowledge him. The verse states that this will happen; it does not say whether all will do so willingly. Isaiah 45:24 goes on to speak of those who were angry with God being put to shame.

decisions.choice: Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: exalted far above all (B); lifted up to the highest honor (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means raised beyond everyone else; Balanced and Readable say that in ordinary words.

decisions.choice: everyone will kneel down; everyone will say out loud
alternatives: every knee will bow; every tongue will confess
decisions.reason: Readable turns the picture of knees and tongues into the people who kneel and speak. Literal and Balanced keep the wording that echoes Isaiah 45:23.

decisions.choice: exaltar por encima de todo
decisions.reason: The verb is "exalt" with a prefix meaning "above" (meaning decision m2). "Por encima de todo" says that in plain Spanish; Readable speaks of the highest honor, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} es Señor
decisions.reason: The confession names Jesus Christ and calls him Lord (meaning decision m5). The span keeps "Jesucristo"; the alternative needs its own comma, so the comma sits inside the span.

decisions.choice: kila goti lipinde
decisions.reason: "Kupinda" is to bend, as the Greek verb says. The idiom "kupiga magoti" (to kneel) is used in Readable, where the English Readable also says "kneel down".

decisions.choice: "주님" for the name above every name, at every level
decisions.reason: The title is the one the Greek Old Testament gives to God (the meaning decision), echoing Isaiah 45:23. Korean "주님" is the respectful form used for Christ through the letter; the confession keeps the honorific "주님이시라고".

decisions.choice: "모든 입" (L, B); "모든 사람" (R) for "every tongue"
decisions.reason: "Every tongue" means every person speaking. Korean "모든 혀" sounds odd; "모든 입" (every mouth) is the natural Korean picture of speech and keeps a body part, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "danh Giê-xu" (L), without the honorific "Đức"
decisions.reason: Here the Greek speaks of the name itself, "Jesus", which every knee will honor (m6). Literal quotes the name without the honorific, as one names a word; Balanced and Readable, which speak of the person, keep "Đức Giê-xu".

decisions.choice: "là Chúa" at every level
decisions.reason: The name above every name is "Lord", the title the Greek Old Testament gives to God (m3, m5). "Chúa" is the Vietnamese word for the Lord at every level, so the reader hears the full weight of the confession.

decisions.choice: elevou acima de tudo; deu como graça (L) / generosamente deu (B)
decisions.reason: The wording is drafted from the Greek, not from the familiar Portuguese of this passage: "elevou acima de tudo" says what the strengthened verb means (m2), and "como graça" / "generosamente" keeps that the verb is related to the word for grace.

decisions.choice: ጌታ (Lord) at every level, the name above every name
decisions.reason: "ጌታ" is the word the Amharic Old Testament gives for God's title Lord, so the confession "ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጌታ ነው" carries the echo of Isaiah 45:23 (meaning decisions on 'Lord'). It stands bare, as in the Greek, not as "ጌታችን".

decisions.choice: አንደበት (tongue, speech)
alternatives: መላስ (the tongue as a body part)
decisions.reason: The Greek's tongue is the organ of speech here; "አንደበት" says that, where "መላስ" would name the body part.

source.text: Ὥστε, ἀγαπητοί μου, καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε, μὴ ὡς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ μου μόνον ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ μου, μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου τὴν ἑαυτῶν σωτηρίαν κατεργάζεσθε, θεὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας.

records.literal_gloss: So then, beloved of me, just as always you obeyed, not as in the presence of me only but now much more in the absence of me, with fear and trembling the of yourselves salvation work out; \v 13 God for is the [one] working in you both the to will and the to work for the good pleasure.

en.L: So then, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, with fear and trembling work out your own salvation; \v 13 for God is the one working in you both to will and to work, for [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] good pleasure.
en.B: So then, my beloved, you have always obeyed. Keep at it now, not only as if I were there with you, but much more because I am away: with fear and trembling, keep working out your own salvation. \v 13 For it is God who is at work in you, producing both the wanting and the doing, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own good pleasure.
en.R: So, my dear friends, you have always obeyed. Keep on obeying, not only as you did when I was with you, but even more now that I am away. Keep working out your own salvation, with deep awe and respect for God. \v 13 God is the one who is at work in you. God gives you the desire to do what pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and the power to do it.

fr.L: Ainsi donc, mes bien-aimés, comme vous avez toujours obéi, non comme en ma présence seulement, mais bien plus maintenant en mon absence, avec crainte et tremblement menez à bien votre propre salut ; \v 13 car Dieu est celui qui agit en vous, et pour vouloir et pour agir, en vue de [{{deity_pronoun:son|Son}}] bon plaisir.
fr.B: Ainsi, mes bien-aimés, vous avez toujours obéi. Continuez maintenant, non seulement comme si j’étais avec vous, mais bien plus encore parce que je suis absent : avec crainte et tremblement, continuez à mener à bien votre propre salut. \v 13 Car c’est Dieu qui est à l’œuvre en vous, et qui fait naître à la fois la volonté et l’action, pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre bon plaisir.
fr.R: Alors, mes chers amis, vous avez toujours obéi. Continuez à obéir, pas seulement comme vous le faisiez quand j’étais avec vous, mais encore plus maintenant que je suis loin. Continuez à mener à bien votre propre salut, avec un profond respect pour Dieu. \v 13 C’est Dieu qui est à l’œuvre en vous. Dieu vous donne l’envie de faire ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît, et la force de le faire.

es.L: Así que, amados míos, tal como siempre {{plural_you:han obedecido|habéis obedecido}}, no solo como en mi presencia, sino ahora mucho más en mi ausencia, con temor y temblor {{plural_you:lleven a cabo su propia|llevad a cabo vuestra propia}} salvación; \v 13 porque Dios es el que obra en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tanto el querer como el obrar, por [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] buena voluntad.
es.B: Así que, amados míos, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} siempre {{plural_you:han obedecido|habéis obedecido}}. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} así ahora, no solo como si yo estuviera con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sino mucho más porque estoy lejos: con temor y temblor, {{plural_you:sigan llevando a cabo su propia|seguid llevando a cabo vuestra propia}} salvación. \v 13 Porque es Dios quien obra en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, produciendo tanto el querer como el hacer, conforme a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} buena voluntad.
es.R: Por eso, queridos amigos, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} siempre {{plural_you:han obedecido|habéis obedecido}}. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} obedeciendo, no solo como cuando yo estaba con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sino todavía más ahora que estoy lejos. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} llevando a cabo {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} propia salvación, con profundo respeto y reverencia hacia Dios. \v 13 Dios es el que obra en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} da el deseo de hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada, y también la fuerza para hacerlo.

sw.L: Basi, wapendwa wangu, kama vile mlivyotii siku zote, si kama nikiwa pamoja nanyi tu, bali sasa zaidi sana nisipokuwapo, ufanyieni kazi wokovu wenu wenyewe kwa hofu na kutetemeka; \v 13 kwa maana Mungu ndiye anayetenda kazi ndani yenu, kutaka na kutenda, kwa ajili ya mapenzi [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}] mema.
sw.B: Basi, wapendwa wangu, siku zote mmetii. Endeleeni hivyo sasa, si kana kwamba niko pamoja nanyi tu, bali zaidi sana kwa sababu niko mbali: kwa hofu na kutetemeka, endeleeni kuufanyia kazi wokovu wenu wenyewe. \v 13 Kwa maana ni Mungu anayetenda kazi ndani yenu, akiwapa kutaka na kutenda, kwa ajili ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mema.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, rafiki zangu wapendwa, siku zote mmetii. Endeleeni kutii, si tu kama mlivyofanya nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi, bali zaidi sasa nikiwa mbali. Endeleeni kuufanyia kazi wokovu wenu wenyewe, mkimcha Mungu na kumheshimu sana. \v 13 Mungu ndiye anayetenda kazi ndani yenu. Mungu huwapa hamu ya kufanya yanayompendeza, na nguvu ya kuyafanya.

ko.L: 그러므로 나의 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분이 언제나 순종했듯이, 내가 함께 있을 때뿐만 아니라 내가 없는 지금 훨씬 더, 두려움과 떨림으로 여러분 자신의 구원을 이루어 가십시오. \v 13 여러분 안에서 [그분의] 기쁘신 뜻을 위하여 원하게도 하시고 행하게도 하시는 분은 하나님이시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분은 언제나 순종해 왔습니다. 내가 함께 있을 때만이 아니라 내가 떠나 있는 지금은 더욱 그렇게 하십시오. 두려움과 떨림으로 여러분 자신의 구원을 계속 이루어 가십시오. \v 13 여러분 안에서 일하셔서, 그분의 기쁘신 뜻을 위해 여러분이 원하게도 하시고 행하게도 하시는 분은 하나님이십니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 사랑하는 친구 여러분, 여러분은 언제나 순종해 왔습니다. 내가 여러분과 함께 있을 때만이 아니라, 내가 떠나 있는 지금은 더욱더 계속 순종하십시오. 하나님을 깊이 경외하고 존경하는 마음으로 여러분의 구원을 계속 이루어 가십시오. \v 13 여러분 안에서 일하시는 분은 하나님이십니다. 하나님께서는 그분을 기쁘시게 하는 일을 하고 싶은 마음도 주시고, 그것을 할 힘도 주십니다.

vi.L: Vậy, thưa những người yêu dấu của tôi, như anh chị em đã luôn luôn vâng lời, không phải chỉ như khi tôi có mặt, nhưng bây giờ, khi tôi vắng mặt, còn hơn thế nữa, hãy lấy lòng kính sợ và run rẩy mà làm cho trọn sự cứu rỗi của mình; \v 13 vì chính Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng hành động trong anh chị em, khiến anh chị em vừa muốn vừa làm theo ý tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa anh chị em yêu dấu của tôi, anh chị em đã luôn luôn vâng lời. Bây giờ hãy tiếp tục như vậy, không những như khi tôi có mặt, mà còn hơn thế nữa khi tôi vắng mặt: hãy lấy lòng kính sợ và run rẩy mà tiếp tục làm cho trọn sự cứu rỗi của mình. \v 13 Vì chính Đức Chúa Trời đang hành động trong anh chị em, khiến anh chị em vừa muốn vừa làm, theo ý tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy, anh chị em thân mến, anh chị em đã luôn luôn vâng lời. Hãy cứ tiếp tục vâng lời, không những như khi tôi ở với anh chị em, mà còn hơn thế nữa bây giờ khi tôi ở xa. Hãy tiếp tục làm cho trọn sự cứu rỗi của mình, với lòng kính sợ và tôn kính sâu xa đối với Đức Chúa Trời. \v 13 Chính Đức Chúa Trời đang hành động trong anh chị em. Ngài ban cho anh chị em lòng mong muốn làm điều đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sức để làm điều đó.

pt.L: Assim, meus amados, como vocês sempre obedeceram, não como na minha presença somente, mas agora muito mais na minha ausência, com temor e tremor levem até o fim a salvação de vocês mesmos; \v 13 pois Deus é quem opera em vocês tanto o querer como o fazer, segundo a [{{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}}] boa vontade.
pt.B: Assim, meus amados, vocês sempre obedeceram. Continuem agora, não só como se eu estivesse aí com vocês, mas muito mais porque estou longe: com temor e tremor, continuem levando adiante a salvação de vocês. \v 13 Pois é Deus quem age em vocês, produzindo tanto o querer como o fazer, segundo a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} boa vontade.
pt.R: Então, meus queridos amigos, vocês sempre obedeceram. Continuem obedecendo, não só como faziam quando eu estava com vocês, mas ainda mais agora que estou longe. Continuem vivendo a salvação de vocês até o fim, com profundo respeito e reverência a Deus. \v 13 É Deus quem está agindo em vocês. Deus dá a vocês a vontade de fazer o que agrada a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e a força para fazer isso.

am.L: ስለዚህ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፣ ሁልጊዜ እንደ ታዘዛችሁ፣ በፊታችሁ እንዳለሁ ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ አሁን ግን በሌለሁበት ጊዜ እጅግ አብልጣችሁ፣ በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ የራሳችሁን መዳን ፈጽሙ፤ \v 13 መፈለግንም መሥራትንም ስለ በጎ ፈቃዱ በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚሠራ እግዚአብሔር ነውና።
am.B: ስለዚህ የተወደዳችሁ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፣ ሁልጊዜ ታዝዛችኋል። አሁንም ቀጥሉበት፤ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር እንዳለሁ ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ይልቁንም አሁን ከእናንተ ስለ ራቅኩ፣ በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ የራሳችሁን መዳን ወደ ፍጻሜው ማድረሳችሁን ቀጥሉ። \v 13 ለበጎ ፈቃዱ መፈለግንም ማድረግንም በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚያደርግ እግዚአብሔር ነውና።
am.R: ስለዚህ ውድ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፣ ሁልጊዜ ታዝዛችኋል። እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ እንደምታደርጉት ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ አሁን ከእናንተ ርቄ ሳለሁ ይበልጥ መታዘዛችሁን ቀጥሉ። እግዚአብሔርን በጥልቅ እያከበራችሁና እየፈራችሁ የራሳችሁን መዳን ወደ ፍጻሜው ማድረሳችሁን ቀጥሉ። \v 13 በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚሠራው እግዚአብሔር ነው። እርሱን ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ለማድረግ ፍላጎቱንም ኃይሉንም የሚሰጣችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

decisions.choice: "not only in my presence" goes with the command to work out salvation
decisions.reason: μὴ is the "not" used with commands, so the phrase belongs to the command at the end of the verse: whether Paul is there or not, keep on. "You have always obeyed" is the example they are to keep following. Their obedience echoes Christ's in verse 8, where the related word "obedient" is used.

decisions.choice: work out: carry through to its goal the salvation God has given
alternatives: work out the well-being of your church
decisions.reason: κατεργάζεσθε means to carry something through to completion. It cannot mean earning salvation: the next verse says God is the one at work in them, and 1:6 says God will finish the good work he began. Salvation here is God's whole saving work, which they live out in their conduct until the day of Christ (1:28, 3:20-21). The "you" is plural, so they do this together, which ties the verse to the appeal for unity in verses 1-4.

decisions.choice: with deep reverence and humility before God
decisions.reason: "Fear and trembling" is a stock phrase for serious, humble reverence: Paul uses it of his own coming to Corinth (1 Corinthians 2:3) and of how slaves should serve (Ephesians 6:5). Psalm 2:11 calls for serving the LORD with fear and rejoicing with trembling. It is not dread of being rejected; verse 13 gives the reason for it.

decisions.choice: they work because God works in them
decisions.reason: γάρ gives the ground of the command. ἐνεργῶν and ἐνεργεῖν are the same verb: God is the one at work, and he works in them both the wish and the action. Their working out does not compete with his working in.

decisions.choice: for God's good pleasure: to do what pleases him
alternatives: for the sake of goodwill among you
decisions.reason: εὐδοκίας is pleasure or good will. The article points to the one just named, God, as in Luke 2:14 and Ephesians 1:5. The word can also mean human goodwill (as in 1:15), but here God is the subject of the sentence.

decisions.choice: with deep awe and respect for God
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (meaning decision m3), and names God, whom the reverence is for; Literal and Balanced keep the phrase.

decisions.choice: keep working out
decisions.reason: The present command means a continuing task; "keep" says so.

decisions.choice: mener à bien votre propre salut
decisions.reason: "Travailler à son salut" can be heard as earning it. The verb means carrying through to its goal the salvation God has given (m2), which "mener à bien" says, and verse 13 then gives the ground: God is at work in them.

decisions.choice: llevar a cabo
decisions.reason: The verb means to carry through to its end (meaning decision m2): the salvation is God's gift, and they are to carry it through. "Llevar a cabo" says that; "trabajar en" could sound like earning it.

decisions.choice: wapendwa wangu (L, B); rafiki zangu wapendwa (R)
decisions.reason: As the project's NT terms for "beloved": "wapendwa" in Literal and Balanced; Readable says "rafiki zangu wapendwa" (my dear friends), as the English Readable does. "Wapenzi" today suggests romantic love.

decisions.choice: "사랑하는 여러분" (L "나의 사랑하는 여러분"; R "사랑하는 친구 여러분") for "my beloved", through the letter
decisions.reason: As with "{{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분": the address keeps the letter's respectful "여러분". Readable says "friends", as the English Readable does, which needs no gender span in Korean.

decisions.choice: "두려움과 떨림으로" (L, B); "하나님을 깊이 경외하고 존경하는 마음으로" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means deep reverence and humility before God (the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep the pair, which Korean readers know; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "thưa những người yêu dấu của tôi" (L); "thưa anh chị em yêu dấu của tôi" (B); "anh chị em thân mến" (R)
decisions.reason: The forms of the Vietnamese Romans (12:19) for the same address: the word means beloved, not brothers, so it takes no gender span; Balanced and Readable add "anh chị em", as a Vietnamese letter would.

decisions.choice: "làm cho trọn sự cứu rỗi của mình" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb is to carry through to its goal the salvation God has given (m2), not to earn it. "Làm cho trọn" says bringing something already begun to completion; verse 13 then says that God is the one at work.

decisions.choice: levem até o fim (L); continuem levando adiante (B); continuem vivendo ... até o fim (R)
decisions.reason: m2: carry through to its goal the salvation God has given. "Trabalhem pela salvação" would sound like earning it, and "desenvolver" now reads as a project or a business plan; the chosen verbs say completion and continuance.

decisions.choice: ፈጽሙ (carry through, L); ወደ ፍጻሜው ማድረስ (bring to its goal, B, R)
decisions.reason: "መዳናችሁን ሥሩ" could be read as earning salvation; the sense is carrying through to its goal the salvation God has given (meaning decision), and verse 13 gives the reason: God is the one at work.

decisions.choice: ወዳጆቼ ሆይ (L); የተወደዳችሁ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ (B); ውድ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ (R)
decisions.reason: Paul's 'my beloved' is given with the possessive, as in the Amharic of 1 Corinthians, so the warmth of the address comes through at every level.

source.text: Πάντα ποιεῖτε χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν, ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι, τέκνα θεοῦ ἄμωμα μέσον γενεᾶς σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης, ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες, εἰς καύχημα ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα.

records.literal_gloss: All things do without grumblings and disputes, \v 15 so that you may become blameless and pure, children of God without blemish in midst of a generation crooked and distorted, among whom you shine as lights in [the] world, \v 16 [the] word of life holding fast, for a boast to me in [the] day of Christ, that not in vain I ran nor in vain I labored.

en.L: Do all things without grumblings and disputes, \v 15 so that you may become blameless and pure, children of God without blemish in [the] midst of a crooked and distorted generation, among whom you shine as lights in [the] world, \v 16 holding fast [the] word of life, for a boast to me in [the] day of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, that I did not run in vain nor labor in vain.
en.B: In all you do, avoid complaining and quarreling, \v 15 so that no one can fault you and you stay pure, God's children without blemish in the midst of a crooked and distorted generation. Among these people you shine like stars in the world \v 16 as you keep a firm grip on the word of life. That way, when the day of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} comes, I can be proud that my running was not wasted and my hard work was not wasted.
en.R: Do everything without complaining or quarreling. \v 15 Then no one will be able to blame you, and you will be pure. You will be God's children with nothing wrong in you, living among the crooked and dishonest people of your time. Among them you shine like stars in the world, \v 16 as you hold on tightly to the message that gives life. Then on the day {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} returns, I will be proud of you. I will know that all my running and hard work were not wasted.

fr.L: Faites toutes choses sans murmures et sans disputes, \v 15 afin que vous deveniez irréprochables et purs, enfants de Dieu sans tache au milieu d’une génération tortueuse et dévoyée, parmi lesquels vous brillez comme des astres dans le monde, \v 16 tenant ferme la parole de vie, pour [être] un sujet de fierté pour moi au jour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, que je n’ai pas couru en vain ni peiné en vain.
fr.B: Dans tout ce que vous faites, évitez de vous plaindre et de vous disputer, \v 15 afin qu’on ne puisse rien vous reprocher et que vous restiez purs, enfants de Dieu sans tache au milieu d’une génération tortueuse et dévoyée. Au milieu de ces gens, vous brillez comme des étoiles dans le monde \v 16 en tenant fermement la parole de vie. Ainsi, quand viendra le jour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, je pourrai être fier de n’avoir pas couru pour rien, ni travaillé dur pour rien.
fr.R: Faites tout sans vous plaindre et sans vous disputer. \v 15 Alors personne ne pourra vous accuser, et vous serez purs. Vous serez des enfants de Dieu sans rien de mal en vous, et vous vivrez au milieu des gens tordus et malhonnêtes de votre époque. Au milieu d’eux, vous brillez comme des étoiles dans le monde, \v 16 en restant bien attachés au message qui donne la vie. Alors, le jour où le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} reviendra, je serai fier de vous. Je saurai que toute ma course et tout mon travail n’ont pas été inutiles.
